text: {"lessons":["Before exiting a losing position, distinguish a genuine change in the investment case from discomfort with a falling price; repeated selling and rebuying can lock in losses without improving the decision.","Treat each trade as part of a coherent plan: review the reasons for both buys and sells, especially when rotating from one stock to another, rather than reacting to recent price moves.","Use partial sales to manage gains, but avoid selling solely because a position is profitable; weigh the remaining upside and risk against the original plan."]}
